title: Leukemia
summary: Leukemia: acute leukemia (considered disabled until ≥24 months from diagnosis or relapse), chronic myelogenous leukemia in accelerated/blast phase, chronic lymphocytic leukemia in advanced stage, OR stem cell transplantation.

children.criterion: Acute leukemia (AML or ALL); considered disabled until at least 24 months from date of diagnosis or relapse, or 12 months from date of bone marrow/stem cell transplantation, whichever is later
Chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) in accelerated phase or blast phase
Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) in Rai stage III/IV or Binet stage C, OR with significant constitutional symptoms
Bone marrow or stem cell transplantation; considered disabled for 12 months from date of transplantation
